name: h11-x
description: SSR and hydration for Bun on top of h11, Vite and regan: multi-page apps with per-route builds
author: Aleksey Malyuta <overby999@gmail.com> (https://github.com/utftu)

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/h11-x.ts --target bun --packages external --outdir ./dist && bun build ./src/h11-x.client.ts --target browser --packages external --outdir ./dist
